en-US.author: Cristiano Bleve
en-US.description: Issue tracking and project management desktop app for software teams.
en-US.longDescription:
Chrono is a lightweight, keyboard-first issue tracking and project management platform built for modern engineering teams.
Features:
- Low-memory standalone desktop runtime powered by Tauri 2 and WebView2 (under 45 MB idle RAM).
- Offline-first architecture with local SQLite database and background Supabase cloud sync.
- Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration for automated AI agents and workflows.
- Interactive onboarding tour, global shortcuts, and custom desktop installer.
en-US.name: Chrono
